is not an event of this service's own topic.

**Owner of each consumed event.** The producing service owns each consumed event: rwb-source-data owns `AceDataReady`, rwb-treatment owns `TreatmentApproved` and rwb-decision owns `RulePackageInForce`; this service owns only the consumer group `rwb-payment.match-run.v1`.

**Payloads.** `ProceedsMatched` carries the identifiers and facts of the modelled proceeds row (`case_id`, `treatment_id`, `account_payment_id`, `source`, `amount`, `received_date`, `matched_to`) in the CloudEvents envelope of Architecture v5 slide 22, keyed by `caseId`; every other field is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1367). The payload of `TreatmentBooked`, named in the event catalogue for rwb-payment, is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1367) and is not published by this step.

edits.old: **Database and migrations.** No Flyway file of this story.
edits.new: **Database and migrations.** No Flyway file of this story. The schemas `rwb_case`, `rwb_decision` and `rwb_treatment` named in this story are owned by rwb-case, rwb-decision and rwb-treatment; this story reads them only through their contracts and writes none of their rows.

edits.old: - No parameter is named in the sources for the step itself; the 2 s budget and the single hop are the platform rule of ADR-020.
edits.new:
- No parameter is named in the sources for the step itself; the 2 s budget and the single hop are the platform rule of ADR-020.
- The outcome fields, the thresholds, the tolerance, the window and the state of the money-side close are rule rows and reference data governed in rwb-decision and never values written in code; this step writes only `matched_to` = `SETTLEMENT` and the references in `rwb_payment.proceeds` (GAP-2511; ASM-4160).

edits.old: **No personal data.** The rows this story writes carry
edits.new:
**API elements.** `Proceeds` carries the nine columns of DF-FIN-001 to DF-FIN-009 (`id`, `case_id`, `treatment_id`, `account_payment_id`, `source`, `amount`, `received_date`, `matched_to`, `posting_ref`); `ProceedsPage` carries the platform pagination convention with the query parameters `matched`, `from`, `to`, `page` and `size` of TSD P8 T-A.2; `MatchRequest` carries `treatment_id` and `account_payment_id` where the receipt carries one. Every other field of these three elements is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1366) and is marked with the placeholder in the document and in its fakes.

edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Access refused (FSD P8 A2.3.4.3, X2)
    Given the role holds neither the Write-off and posting right R for GET /proceeds nor the right U for POST /proceeds/{proceedsId}/match
    When the role reads the proceeds list or attempts the match
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 before any read or write
    Then nothing changes and no decision record is written

  Scenario: AC4 Boundary held at build (DP-01, DP-05, X8)
    Given the build contains the statements of rwb-payment
    When the boundary test runs
    Then a statement that reaches a v_ace_* view or a row of rwb_case, rwb_treatment or rwb_decision fails the build
    Then nothing is released

edits.new: The two criteria are the legacy criteria of RWB-E4-043 word for word, with their origin tag added and nothing else changed (requirement reference: FEAT-PAY-03 with AC-P8-003-01, in place of a requirement ID):

edits.new: The two rows VR-P8-003-1 and BR-P8-003 are the rows of FSD P8 A2.3.3.1, copied character for character; the rest are the rules the target split fixes. Coverage: VR-P8-003-1 and BR-P8-003 carry their own rule IDs as their BR IDs and are cited by those IDs; BR1, BR2 and BR7 by TC-E4-043-06; BR3 and BR4 by AC1, AC2, TC-E4-043-01 and TC-E4-043-02; BR5, BR6 and BR8 by AC4 and TC-E4-043-05; BR9, BR10 and BR11 by TC-E4-043-07.

edits.new: The rights are the rows of TSD P8 T6.1 and of the legacy permission table of this key, and nothing wider. Each operation is authorised by the rwb-access check of the capability area Write-off and posting and of its right, R for `GET /proceeds` and U for `POST /proceeds/{proceedsId}/match`, made before any read or write.

| TC-E4-043-05 | Boundary | Build | No statement outside `rwb_payment`, no `v_ace_*` read and no write to `rwb_case`, `rwb_treatment` or `rwb_decision`; the build fails on any of them (AC4; BR5, BR6, BR8) |
